name: Gasorinsutando
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood gas station, Soyokaze Gasorinsutando: a New Year business-hours notice, a first day helping at the station, a car-wash price guide, a trial free tire-pressure check corner notice, an oil-change reservation application guide, a column about noticing a regular customer's change in mood during a routine tire check, a lesson teaching a new kouhai how to handle the fuel nozzle and inspection tools safely, an explainer on why in-person inspection is still valued as self-service and app payment spread, a new rule for year-end car-wash reservations, a winter tire-inspection campaign's new reservation rule, an application guide for vehicle-inspection (shaken) bookings during the fiscal year-end rush, a notice about a temporary self-service lane closure for renovation, and a one-year cooperation report with a local elementary school's bicycle traffic-safety education program. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
